First to four-of-a-kind calls 'Vatra!' Loser (last without) gets punishment: winner shuffles deck, loser names a card, cards flipped â€” each suit before that card = specific physical penalty.

Vatra (Fire) and Magarac (Jackass) are versions of Pig without a stock played in Bosnia and Herzegovina. They belong to the card-passing family; players pass cards in turn rather than simultaneously like basic Pig. Vatra uses physical punishment and is traditionally played by young boys.
Use 4 cards per player (one complete rank each). Extra deck for punishment.
